entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: R. Raghunandan Rao
Bench: R. Raghunandan Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice R. Raghunandan Rao
 Criminal Petition No.9034 of 2022
Order:

The petitioner is arrayed as accused No.3 in C.C.No.160 of 2017 on the file of Judicial Magistrate of First Class at Itchapuram, Srikakulam District for offences under Sections 270 & 273 of Indian Penal Code, on the ground that the petitioner is caught storing and transporting the tobacco and tobacco products.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class at Itchapuram
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The cases are being booked against persons, who are found to be either storing or transporting tobacco or tobacco products in the State of Andhra Pradesh.

Persons, who are facing such cases,
have been approaching this Court for relief.

3. In Crl.P.No.5421 of 2019 and batch dated 18.12.2019, a learned Single Judge of this Court had held that tobacco does not fall within the definitions of "food" and as such, registration of Crime under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is not permissible.

4. In W.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018, a learned Single Judge of this Court had held the police would not have jurisdiction to initiate or investigate any offences punishable under the provision of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A learned Single Judge had also held that transport or storage of tobacco and tobacco products would not constitute an offence punishable under Sections 270 to 273 of Indian Penal Code.

5. In view of the aforesaid findings which are being consistently followed by this Court, this Criminal Petition is allowed quashing the C.C.No.160 of 2017 on the file of Judicial Magistrate of First Class at Itchapuram, Srikakulam District, against the petitioner.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class at Itchapuram, Srikakulam District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO, J 15.11.2022 BSM HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE R. RAGHUNANDAN RAO CRIMINAL PETITION No.9034 of 2022 15.11.2022
